project.name: Desktop 6-DOF Arm
project.summary: Design and manufacture a desktop six-axis robotic manipulator for moving payloads across a desk.

payload_mass_kg.notes: Useful payload mass; excludes gripper/tool mass, which must be included in joint load calculations.
payload_mass_kg.source: User-provided design target; not yet validated by analysis or test.

reach_mm.notes: Approximately 15 in, measured from base rotation axis to tool center point at full extension; workspace layout remains to be defined.
reach_mm.source: User-provided design target; not yet validated by CAD or test.

workspace.notes: Desk-level transfer between opposite sides of the usable workspace; exact endpoints, heights, base placement, and obstacles remain undefined.

end_effector.notes: Actuator and finger geometry are not selected or tested.

payload_capacity_kg.notes: Useful payload target; not yet validated. Establish joint capacity after link geometry, gripper/tool mass, reducer efficiency, and motion loads are known.

joint_speed_deg_per_s.notes: No per-joint speed requirement set; the system-level transfer time is specified separately.

cycle_time_s.notes: Maximum move time between opposite sides of the usable workspace with the full target payload; exact endpoints and whether grasp/release time is excluded need confirmation.

encoder.mounting: motor shaft; does not measure reducer output behavior

reducer.status: manufactured units on bench; characterization in progress

prototype_configuration.controller: Arduino Uno for the single-joint prototype

available_bench_supply.note: Available prototype supply; not a finalized full-arm power budget.

reducer_test_settings.force_zero_threshold_status: placeholder; set from measured noise floor

acceptance_targets.status: measure reducer first; no acceptance limits specified yet

demo_use_cases.notes: Confirm specific device and mount/adapter mass fit within the 0.5 kg useful payload target.
Camera and mount mass varies; not guaranteed within the target payload.
